artifact_name: P2-06.5 classifier config — B-23 description boilerplate
decision: B-23 (主控裁决 2026-10-01): 只修公版老书套话简介一类。简介命中套话清单时，简介不参与关键词匹配，标题照常匹配。

extends.note: Weights, threshold and maxTextTags are read from the frozen Owner Final artifact, which is not modified. Only the description boilerplate rule is new.

description_boilerplate.disable_note: Set enabled to false to switch the rule off as a whole. The production config then resolves to the extended Owner Final config itself (same version string, same fingerprint, no boilerplate key), so classification is byte-for-byte what it was before B-23 and a reclassification needs the old fingerprint again.

not_changed: keyword-eligibility-v2 (Owner Final 2026-08-17) and the CanonicalTag/keyword lexicon

Alpha used figuratively and French 'chef' are observation items, not rules: single-sample cases get no rule and blanket per-locale suppression falsely removed ~40% of correct tags (keyword-eligibility-v2 notes)
Upstream-mapped (source label) tags and manual tags: this rule is read only by the deterministic text classifier
